reference.pathophysiology: Stevens-Johnson syndrome and toxic epidermal necrolysis are one drug-triggered necrolytic spectrum: detachment under ten percent is SJS, ten to thirty is overlap, above thirty is TEN. Fever, sore throat and burning eyes precede dusky macules that coalesce with positive Nikolsky and at least two mucosal sites eroded. Full-thickness keratinocyte death comes from granulysin and Fas-mediated apoptosis, leaving denuded dermis that loses fluid, protein and barrier defence like a burn.
